name: Urza's Crystal Orb
description: A dark crystal orb in a cage of silver vines hidden in the monument, one of Urza's devices that could help repair a time rift.

timeline.summary: Teferi retrieves the crystal orb Urza hid.
timeline.quote: Teferi held a delicate dark crystal orb nestled in a cage of silver vines.
